structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 a month, I'd have about 68,853 ₪ according to the calculator. For 4 years it gives no number: it says there's no calculation for self-employed people who take the money out before 6 years, just that you pay tax.

stuck.why: Years 1-5 are empty dashed boxes and the only number on screen is 25,725, which is under 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך', not the fund. I nearly took that as my answer.
The labels are under the bars, a scroll below the numbers, so at first I didn't know which number was mine.

used: Orange note 'לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים'
Bars: הפקדתם 48,000, נשאר בידיים 68,853, אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך 25,725 / 55,471
skimmed: Bar labels החזר המס הוסיף / התשואה הוסיפה / המס לקח
skipped: Grey text under the chart (7%, 2% inflation, ילין לפידות)
Income, return and fee fields (left at defaults)
Tabs שווה לדעת, מי מציע ומי מצטרף
not_found: Any amount for the fund itself when withdrawing after 4 years as self-employed
A clear statement of how much tax is lost if you withdraw early

findings.what: At 4 years there's no number for the fund, only empty boxes and a note. The one big number shown belongs to a different account, so it's easy to read it as the answer.
The labels for the bars are below them, a scroll away from the numbers, and the main white bar has no word next to its number.
findings.where: Bar chart under 'מושכים את הכסף אחרי'

findings.what: 'החזר המס הוסיף' isn't explained. I don't know why I'd get money back.
'הכנסה חייבת' as the first field label means nothing to me
The line about 13,205 ₪ a year shows up without context
